navy.use: Primary dark: header, hero, dark sections, text on orange

ink.use: Darkest: footer, dispatch board, stranded mode

orange.use: Accent: buttons (with NAVY text), highlights on dark

orange-text.use: Orange TEXT on white/light (4.5:1). Never use #FF6B00 for small text on white

button.primary: bg #FF6B00, text #101D32, Montserrat 800, min-height 48px (60px large), radius 14px, phone icon
button.secondary: transparent, 1.5px border (white 35% on dark / #C9D0DA on light), Montserrat 700

motifs: Dashed road line (white dashes on asphalt #1B2433) - How it works
Hazard stripes: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #101D32 0 16px, #FF6B00 16px 32px), 14px tall - call band edges
Huge faded italic word (e.g. CALGARY, #F1F3F6) behind editorial sections
accessibility: All tap targets >= 44px. Body text contrast >= 4.5:1. One H1 per page.
